messages:
eli: I'm going through the Python quickstart sample and my first call returns 402 Payment required. Response: {"error":"payment_required_trial_expired","message":"Trial credits exhausted; please add billing info to continue"}. I thought new workspaces get trial credits automatically?

harper: Are you using a brand-new workspace created via the CLI or the Console? We recently changed the flow: workspaces created from some partner signup flows don't auto-apply trial credits.

eli: Created via `rw init` on my laptop (local dev). Console shows workspace wks_abc123 with "trial_status: pending".

harper: Ah there it is. Pending means the finance job hasn't provisioned trial funds. Usually takes ~5-10m, or requires admin to opt-in for partner orgs. Did you invite your org admin?

devex-bot: Docs: Trial credits & billing gating -> https://docs.redwood.ai/billing#trial-credits. Note: partner-created workspaces may require admin opt-in.

eli: Hmm, I didn't see that in the quickstart. The README just says "new workspaces receive trial credits". Can we make that explicit? Had me stuck for 20m.

harper: Filing a doc note now. Also, temporary workaround: you can run the sample against a personal workspace or ask an admin to accept trial in Console -> Billing -> Trial offers -> Accept.

billing-bot: If you paste the workspace id (wks_abc123) I can check provisioning status.

eli: wks_abc123. Thanks.

billing-bot: Provisioning status: partner_signup_pending. ETA: manual accept by admin or support ticket.

harper: If this blocks onboarding flows (esp in our partner templates), let's add a guard in the quickstart script to detect 402 and print a clearer message linking to Console steps. Small PR?

eli: Would help. Also the SDK client returned a generic HTTPError without the friendly message; perhaps we can unwrap billing error codes into friendlier text in the SDK to prevent confusion.

harper: Good call. I'll spin up a tiny SDK patch to map payment_required_trial_expired -> actionable error with link.

eli: Thanks! Once admin accepts I can re-run and confirm.

harper: Nice catch — appreciate the report :shipit:
